_comment: One entry per project. 'extra' adds allowlist paths on top of config/gitleaks.base.toml. 'note' carries the project's own reason, and lands in the generated file as a comment. Keep every extra path justified: it is the only place a project can widen the scan.

ApolloMatrix.note: Rendered images and the glyph fixture are dense binary/hex blobs whose runs look like credentials to the entropy heuristics. Nothing authored by hand is allowlisted, so a real secret in the config, docs or scripts is still caught.

ChromaWOTD.note: Vendored Seeed_GFX / Adafruit GFX font tables are dense binary blobs. The secrets TEMPLATE is safe by construction and is meant to be committed; the real secrets.h is gitignored and never tracked.

display.note: 4-colour BWRY panel, one landscape presentation. These four files are the byte-compared ledger.

eClock.note: The vendored board variant ships compiled mbed libraries, whose .a files trip the generic lookalike heuristics.

display.note: GDEY029T94, 1-bit, 296x128. state_matrix_approval.png is a contact sheet of states, not a panel render.

GBOGH.note: The vendored GxEPD2 / Adafruit GFX trees, the vendored QR encoder and the generated 1-bit digit atlas are machine-written ink data. This project has no compile-time credential path: Wi-Fi credentials exist only in the device NVS, written by the setup portal.

display.note: GDEY0426T82, 800x480. face_variants_800x480.png is a contact sheet, not a panel render.

GarminSteampunkWatchface.note: Image binaries (renders, artwork, the AI art's C2PA provenance certificates) and compiled bitmap-font atlases can trip the high-entropy heuristics; they hold no credentials. The real secret here is the Connect IQ signing key in ciq/keys/, which is gitignored and which nothing allowlists.

ThirdAbove.note: The live trainer page carries mock strings that match the generic rules. This project is the oldest config and the weakest: review these two entries before the next release.

tts-voice-experiments.note: Audio renders, Piper ONNX weights and the local interpreter hold long high-entropy byte runs that are not secrets and are re-generatable.
